scripts.dev: bun run storage:check && bun run scripts/dev.ts tauri dev -- --profile=release-with-debug
scripts.build: bun run storage:check && bun run scripts/dev.ts tauri build --no-bundle
scripts.cargo: bun run storage:check && bun run scripts/dev.ts cargo
scripts.clean:rust:dev: bun run scripts/dev.ts cargo clean --profile dev
scripts.clean:rust:release: bun run scripts/dev.ts cargo clean --profile release
scripts.clean:rust:desktop: bun run scripts/dev.ts cargo clean --profile release-with-debug
scripts.format: oxfmt ui scripts/check-generated.ts scripts/check-generated.test.ts scripts/storage.ts scripts/storage.test.ts package.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check ui scripts/check-generated.ts scripts/check-generated.test.ts scripts/storage.ts scripts/storage.test.ts package.json .oxfmtrc.json .vscode
scripts.generate:openapi: bun cargo run -p koharu-rpc --bin openapi -- ui/openapi.json
scripts.generate:api: bun run generate:openapi && bun run --filter ui generate:api && bun run format:generated
scripts.check:generated: bun run generate:api && bun run verify:generated
